notes.title: amazin' George Remastered Update
notes.content:
Celebrate with us for the launch of the amazin' George franchise with a beautifully presented remaster of amazin' George, using the latest 3D technologies

-Join George in his quest to find his master after entering the dream maze
-Improved gameplay and amazing models and textures.

An even greater experience but with the option to still play 'classic' amazin' George.

- Improved gameplay and amazing models and textures.

notes.title: Bugfix Update
notes.content: We've fixed a few bugs and updated the Spacefarer logo.

notes.title: Content Update! (v1.2)
notes.content:
-We've added enemies in the game, the Naughty Fungi, who steal treats from you should they catch you, adding extra challenge to the game. We've adjusted in-game time accordingly to balance this.
-We've added a new maze to the Winter Pass where you must save all the piggies!
-We've fixed a bug that could cause the balls of wool to dissapear at certain viewing angles.

notes.title: Day One Patch Three, meow!
notes.content:
We just want to say thank you to all the reviewers, let's players and new players for giving feedback on amazin' George. We've fixed most, if not all, day one release issues and bugs and the game is now purrrfect for players.

We will also be updating the manual and survival guide, along with more content coming soon.

Specific fixes-
-Title Animation has been fixed
-AMD graphics would sometimes garble the intro, this has been fixed.
-The spacefarer logo aspect ratio has been fixed to 16:10 from 4:3 to match the rest of the game size.

tags.bug: - AMD graphics would sometimes garble the intro, this has been fixed.
- The spacefarer logo aspect ratio has been fixed to 16:10 from 4:3 to match the rest of the game size.

notes.title: Day One (v1.1.2) Patch
notes.content:
As always, thank you dear players for your feedback!
-We've added the ability to freely rotate and zoom in / out the camera with the mouse, making finding those mouseys and items even easier and immerse yourself in the beautfiul retro art!
-We've fixed an issue with the title screen that could cause a indefinate loading loop
-We've fixed an issue that would cause a profiling error message to appear with node.js
-We've upgraded node.js for faster rendering
-We've improved loading performance for maps
